parts:
Hello Shiny-Community, 

I have a problem with my first own Shinyapp. It gives out the maximum, minimum and the mean temperature as a simply timeplot for a given period. Additionally, you can show a smoothed curve (loess). The loess-curve works perfectly unless the left controller of the sliderinput period is moved from left to right. Why? It gives me the error: variable lengths are different (found for "x").

I hope someone can help me. Thank you very much. 


Best regards, 

Dominic
